subtasks.title: Implement and export slugify
subtasks.goal:
Add ASCII slug normalization using named ES module exports.
New src/slug.mjs → export function slugify(text), returning text.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').
src/index.mjs version-only export → preserve export const version = 1 and append export { slugify } from './slug.mjs', following its semicolon-free style.
Existing tests → unchanged; create no test files or dependencies.
